titolo: Anthropic adds Google Drive file browser to Claude for Pro and Max users
descr: Claude now lets users browse, search and manage Drive files from a sidebar, expanding its workspace capabilities.
paragrafi: Anthropic is testing a Google Drive integration that adds a file‑browser to Claude’s navigation sidebar.
The interface shows Docs, Sheets and Slides, allowing users to search, filter, move files between folders and attach them to projects.
The feature is currently in beta for select Pro and Max users in cloud sessions and will roll out to all Claude users soon.
Claude already supports Google Drive through connectors that let users add files to chats, edit Docs live and save generated files.
The new browser mirrors similar Drive management tools seen in OpenAI’s ChatGPT Spaces, suggesting a move toward a more unified workspace.
perche: For AI users, the integration reduces context‑switching by keeping Drive actions inside Claude, improving productivity. Free‑model users still lack comparable built‑in file management, highlighting a functional gap between paid AI services and open alternatives.
